rv.q: There are plays you see and enjoy and that's about it, but few stick with you so deeply that you find yourself thinking about them hours and even days after they're over.
Director Jaime Robledo, known previously for his fantastic visual and staging sense, gets great dramatic work from his cast, demonstrating his skill with more delicate material as well.

cn.t: Critics largely praise *Recent Alien Abductions*, with its blend of X-Files nostalgia and childhood trauma resonating strongly. A standout West Coast Premiere for Sacred Fools, though reactions vary slightly in enthusiasm.
